prompt:
Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1135
Claimant:
Jon Ellis
Adjuster:
Christopher Wong
10/07/2023
Claim opened after a rear-end collision reported by the insured's driver, who is named on the policy. The claimant
reports neck pain and has not retained a lawyer.
10/20/2023
Police report and two independent witnesses confirm the accident happened as described, and the other driver's
account matches. Photos of the rear bumper are on file.
11/10/2023
Police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle at the time of impact. Claimant gave a statement that is
consistent with the initial report.
11/15/2023
Reviewed the vehicle's prior repair history. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known, and nothing suggests the
damage predates the start of coverage.
11/20/2023
Claimant was seen at urgent care the same day and diagnosed with whiplash. The reported injury is plausible for a
crash of this type.
12/01/2023
Claimant described the same account of the collision in every conversation so far. No changes to the timeline or
sequence have come up.
12/11/2023
Claimant's records show a minor strain in the same neck area several years ago, which healed fully according to the
prior provider notes.
01/22/2024
Treatment has run somewhat longer than is typical for this injury. Requested a updated treatment plan and records
from the treating clinic.
02/07/2024
Clinic records are received. Physical therapy visits continue, and the notes describe gradual improvement with some
ongoing stiffness.
02/23/2024
Reviewed the damage estimate against the photos. It is not clear yet whether all of the claimed damage came from
this impact, so the question is open.
04/15/2024
Sent a request to the medical reviewer to assess how much of the current treatment relates to this collision, given the
earlier strain.
04/19/2024
File remains open pending the medical reviewer's opinion on causation and the final treatment update from the clinic.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
{"findings": [{"feature": "", "rating": "", "confidence": "", "quote": "", "reason": ""}]}
